lines.text: You have a powerful computer of your own at home, and you are out with a slim laptop. The big one sits idle.
Meanwhile your laptop struggles, and a rented cloud machine costs money you would rather not spend.
Install the Agent R Q D daemon on the big computer. It is one small program that runs in the background.
Enrol it with a single-use code from Agent R Q. The code works once, then it is spent.
And the computer appears in Agent R Q as a machine, online, with its name and its load.
From the control panel, start your coding agents on it, each in the right repository.
Watch the load climb as the agents work. The idle box finally earns its keep.
Open its live terminal from any browser, and see exactly what each agent is doing.
Run several agents at once, one per repository, because the box has the muscle for it.
Approvals still apply, so the powerful machine only does what you allow, wherever you are.
Your own hardware, working while you are somewhere else, with no extra cloud bill.
What is the beefiest computer you own that sits idle? Tell us, or enrol it at Agent R Q dot com.
